claim: Gravesend's secrets should not lie open to whoever passes: the owner asked that they be shut behind bars worked by a valve wheel (tile 982), or behind a button of bloody hands made as a sector that gives a little when pressed. The study adds Blood's own: something that sinks when pushed (E3M3 s264), and the tell: of 70 panels that are their own button 63 differ from the wall beside them, while of 54 worked from elsewhere 39 wear the wall's own tile.
evidence: the owner, 2026-11-25: 'Some secret locations are too visible and easy to access ... it should be closed behind bars or something where you will have wheel as a switch (picnum 982), there are other types of buttons as well, in some levels there is like a button with bloody hands made as a sector that goes back a little when pressed' (projects/blood-city/level/secret_places.py:3-7)
E3M3 s264 (a straw bed on boxes: type 600, wall-push, drops 5,120 and comes back after wait 40); E1M2 s261 (marked slide, rx 160)

E3M3 holds the two halves separately: its bars s254 (type 602, rx 129) are raised by levers of tile 1070 (sprites 199, 201, tx 129); its valve wheels, sprites 107 and 108 (kSwitchToggle, picnum 982, tx 124/125), work Z sectors s94 and s93, which feed a combination switch (sprite 349, tx 128) that opens s96. A wheel lifting bars is Gravesend's composition (secret_places.py) of two Blood precedents
knowledge/blood/studies/secrets/notes.md:60-65 (the tell: own button 70, of which 32 another tile, 9 another palette, 21 own bay, 7 identical; worked from elsewhere 54, of which 25 identical)
use: Hide each secret by one of these; read the study before choosing.

checked.how: Owner's words at secret_places.py:3-7 (2026-11-25): bars with a wheel (982), a bloody-hands button sector that goes back when pressed. The sinking bed and the tell rule are the study's (secrets/notes.md:60-65: own-button 70, 63 differ; elsewhere 54, 25 identical, 39 same tile). Records: E3M3 s264 type 600, wall push, 52,224 to 57,344, wait 40; E1M2 s261 type 614 rx 160; s254 type 602 rx 129; sprites 199/201 tile 1070 tx 129; 107/108 tile 982 tx 124/125; s94/s93 tx 126; sprite 349 kSwitchCombo tx 128; s96 rx 128.
